text:
[NDLC.4.5] The compiled `.dsc` artefact records the program's resolved
settings and the capabilities it requires in its `CapabilityInfo` atom
([RDSC.16.2]), and the dialect's name, for information, in a
`DialectInfo` atom. The binding tuple carries the settings, not the name;
loading artefacts whose settings disagree fails with
`DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH` (see [NRTM.6]
and [NERR.11]).

---
